'opening_range_volume_weighted_breakout' further refines the breakout signal by incorporating volume-weighted price changes, enhancing the conviction behind the breakout. Lastly, 'volume_weighted_price_change' provides insights into price movements influenced by trading volumes, which can help gauge the strength and sustainability of price trends, adding a microstructure perspective to the analysis.
